page.layout: One printed title page, one block of centred lines in the middle of the page. No running head, no page number, no margin text.

main_text.l: PER SEBASTIANVM HENRICPETRI, ANNO HVMANITATIS FILII DEI, CIↃ. IↃ. XXCVI.

page.notes: The title is set in mixed capitals and small capitals. The first line reads "BASILEAE HELVETIORVM," with the first letters enlarged; "HEL" is followed by a swash-like "ƨ" terminal, read as the printed form of "Helvetiorum". The date line "CIↃ. IↃ. XXCVI." is printed as in the original, with the reversed-C numerals; rendered here as MDXCVI in the Roman form intended by the printer, with the printed "XXCVI" kept as printed. The faint ghost of a woodcut or engraving appears behind the title, not transcribed. Show-through from the reverse side is ignored.
